The business

K&K Hospitality brings together ownership, investment, culinary experience, restaurant development and day-to-day operations.

We are developing our own venues, starting with Kohantei at The Galleria Abu Dhabi. We also work with owners, investors, landlords and developers who need experienced support — to assess an opportunity, develop a concept, open a venue or manage an existing operation.

Who we work with

Owners & investors

Assessing an opportunity, developing a concept or improving an operating venue.

Landlords & developers

Hospitality concepts for hotels, malls and mixed-use destinations.

Brands entering the region

International brands entering the UAE or GCC, and regional concepts expanding abroad.

Existing venues

Repositioning, stronger controls or experienced management.

The principles

The concept must make sense for its market.
The commercial structure must be workable.
The operation must be built properly.

The format may change. The principles do not.

How we work with you

The same owner-and-operator thinking behind our own venues is available to selected clients — from the first idea to an operating business. The role depends on what the owner needs and how much responsibility K&K is expected to take.

01

Investment & partnership

For selected opportunities where K&K invests, partners, develops or operates — a focused portfolio of venues we are closely involved in, rather than a long list of concepts.

02

Consultancy

A defined review before significant time and capital is committed: the market, location, audience, concept positioning, commercial assumptions and operating model behind the idea.

03

Development & pre-opening

Practical leadership from operating brief to opening day — guest journey, kitchen and operational requirements, budgets, recruitment, suppliers, systems, training and readiness — keeping the operation at the centre of a process that too often becomes rushed.

04

Owner representation

An independent view for owners who cannot be inside every discussion: landlord liaison, coordination of appointed consultants, monitoring of key decisions and clear reporting on the project or the operating business.

05

Management

Direct responsibility for running the venue under an agreed structure of authority — leadership, financial controls, people, purchasing, service standards and commercial reporting. Continuing responsibility for the business, not only advice.

Market entry

For brands entering the UAE or GCC and regional concepts expanding abroad, we combine these roles as the opportunity requires. Legal, tax, franchise documentation and authority approvals remain with the appropriate appointed professionals.

Mohamed Kamali

Managing Director
Investment and hospitality development

An owner and investor whose understanding of hospitality is not only financial: Mohamed previously worked as a chef in Los Angeles under a renowned Michelin-starred chef. At K&K he leads opportunity assessment, investment strategy, commercial structure and concept positioning, and is closely involved in Kohantei from both the ownership and the concept side.

Portrait to follow

Mihai Giurebe

General Manager
Operations and development

Extensive restaurant development and operating experience across the UAE and GCC: Mihai has led teams of more than 100, opened premium restaurant concepts in Dubai and led a major opening recognised as Michelin Opening of the Year. He leads the development and pre-opening of Kohantei — project coordination, landlord liaison, team, systems and opening readiness.

The partnership

Mohamed looks at the opportunity as an investor, an owner and someone who has worked inside a professional kitchen. Mihai looks at how it will be developed, opened, staffed, controlled and run every day.

Our market

Based in the UAE, open to the right opportunity.

The UAE is our home market — we understand its landlords, developers, investment environment and the expectations of a very diverse guest base. Our immediate focus is the UAE and GCC; the right partnership, concept or location can be considered wherever K&K can bring genuine value and remain properly involved.
